pages.title: Eternal Conquest
pages.text: Requires a Draconic Authority Ingot, Nether Star, Torchflower, Calming Tibia, Heart-Devouring Remnant, Famine Core, and Life-Binding Remnant Crystal. After all nine curses are truly reversed, five personal kills of Tier IX royal-shield enemies grant one tempering level by default.

pages.title: Campfire Group U
pages.text: Raw Group U can be cooked in a furnace, smoker, or campfire. All three processing recipes are recorded here.
